bullets.text: Rockstar's Union Battle Continues - A UK tribunal denied interim pay for fired **Rockstar Games** employees amid union busting claims.
UK's Deepfake Law Enforced - New legislation criminalizes non-consensual deepfake images, targeting **Grok AI** content.
Harmattan AI Soars to Unicorn Status - The defense tech firm raised $200M, bolstered by **Dassault Aviation** support.
Meta's Layoffs Hit Metaverse Team - **Meta** plans to cut 10% of its Reality Labs staff as focus shifts to AI.
Amazon's AI Wearable Bee Unveiled - **Amazon** introduces Bee, an AI device for recording and summarizing conversations.
Claude for Healthcare Launched - **Anthropic** introduces Claude for Healthcare, enhancing AI capabilities for medical professionals.
Apple Chooses Google for AI - **Apple** partners with **Google** to enhance Siri with advanced AI capabilities.
Betterment Faces Data Breach - **Betterment** confirms a data breach affecting customer information through a social engineering attack.
